hook: Everyone wants a million dollars, but almost nobody knows what it actually buys in 2027. I break down what $1 million means as income, as a house, as retirement, and why three people with the same million can live completely different lives.
shorts: Everyone wants a million dollars. Almost nobody knows what it buys
Before sixty five, health insurance can eat half your million dollar income
Three people have one million dollars. Only one of them is free
Why does a million dollars feel like less than you expected?
Here's how to make one million dollars last for the rest of your life
